name: mathbox
description: Mathbox plugin skills for rigorous AI-assisted mathematical research

interface.longDescription: The Mathbox plugin provides skills to audit proofs, verify literature, design reproducible computations, and manage rigorous AI-assisted mathematical research workflows.
defaultPrompt: Audit this proof and isolate the first unproved implication.
Verify the exact hypotheses and conclusion of this cited theorem.
Design a reproducible computation to test this mathematical claim.
